title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘regrets that the legal framework for combating gender-based violence is not yet aligned with the Istanbul Convention;’
part_context: Is concerned that, in the global rankings published in the World Economic Forum’s Global Gender Gap Report 2025, Albania fell from 23rd place in 2024 to 36th place in 2025, indicating a widening gender gap; <del>regrets that the legal framework for combating gender-based violence is not yet aligned with the Istanbul Convention;</del> urges the Albanian Government to enhance support services for victims, particularly in healthcare, funding for women’s shelters, free legal aid, and reintegration and rehabilitation programmes;
